_about: Single source of facts and deployment switches for the website. A value of null means 'not confirmed by the owner yet': the build leaves it out of the structured data, shows the design's [placeholder] where the design had one, and lists it in the FILL report. Go-live = change baseUrl, set staging to false, set customDomain, run `node site-src/build.mjs`.
